description: Comprehensive Architecture Refactoring, Account Management Security, Authentication Overhaul, and Persistent UX enhancements.

tasks: Migrated raw authentication handlers into dedicated abstractions: FirebaseEmailPasswordAuth and FirebaseGoogleAuth.
Refactored the Login and Registration screens using Jetpack Compose to incorporate robust loading states, contextual error dialogues, and graceful UX feedback loops.
Engineered reliable exception casting for errors like FirebaseAuthRecentLoginRequiredException to guide users clearly.
Configured a sequential, multi-step onboarding flow for newly registered accounts.
Designed and routed specialized compositional screens for Physical Details (Height, Weight, ExperienceLevel) and Gender Selection.
Programmed a strict popUpTo back-stack manipulation sequence to prevent users from accidentally backing out into the Auth boundaries after logging in.
Deleted FitnessActivity.kt entirely as dead structural code; consolidated the universal application entry point cleanly into MainAppContainer.
Refactored the core Settings screen into distinctive sub-routed screens: UpdateUsername, Theme Settings, Unit Settings, Reminder Settings, and Default Rest Settings.
Engineered the AccountScreen with a state-driven BottomSheet containing bifurcated stages (MAIN_OPTIONS, SOURCE_SELECTION) for a highly professional Profile Image modification experience.
Built automatic zombie file sweeper routines utilizing ImageStorageUtils to rigorously delete local Profile Pictures from the Internal Storage upon an Image Reset or complete Account Deletion.
Resolved critical rotation crashes and Process Death context leaks by establishing MainViewModel as the Single Source of Truth for sensitive mutations.
Transferred vulnerable inline updateUsername suspending functions directly into MainViewModel's dedicated viewModelScope.
Transferred heavy, multi-step Account Deletion processes (Firestore wipe -> Auth wipe -> Local File wipe) into MainViewModel's deleteUserAccount function.
Created hoisted boolean properties (isUpdatingUsername, isDeletingAccount) passed down precisely to the Composables to drive progress indicators immutably during orientation changes.
Replaced fragile 'remember { mutableStateOf() }' text bindings in UpdateUsernameScreen with 'rememberSaveable' to actively preserve user typing amidst Device Configurations.
Identified dangerous eternal background snapshot bindings; constructed a strict MutableList<ListenerRegistration> cache inside UserDataManager.
Programmed a clearAllListeners() cycle which systematically removes and clears every single database connection, definitively executed upon User Logout or Account Deletion.

Refactored the 'Today's Sets' data listener off a static hardcoded App-Boot date, shifting it to a dynamic request via setupTodaySetsListener(userId) that can be refreshed predictably past midnight boundaries.
Unified scattered single-line SetOptions.merge() mapping updates behind a powerful, type-safe, and reusable updateUserSetting(userId, key, value) method.
Abstracted volatile in-line mathematical operations (* 0.45359237) natively into structurally isolated helper formulas: convertToStorageWeight (Lbs -> Kg) and convertToDisplayWeight (Kg -> Lbs).
Cleaned redundant UI logic and corrected missing androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope mappings to assure building resilience without runtime syntax exceptions.
